Seven complete proofs use actual APIs and retain original physical rho,density,coprime/distribution definitions and RealB counting semantics. No analytic supplier or eventual wrapper integration.
complete_source:
import ImbalancedChen.RealPhysicalUpperWeightBridge
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq

/-!
# Signed-shift finite outer bridge for the actual physical upper weight

SOURCE PROPOSAL ONLY -- UNCOMPILED -- HOLD -- 2026-10-22.
The receiver is the natAbs of the integer difference N-m, including m>N.
All finite sums keep the identical rho and the original source/coprime/
discrepancy definitions. No density or distribution estimate is supplied.
The original RealB, natural sieve cap and complete-product trim cost remain.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators

/-- Integer-shift divisibility is exactly the original natural congruence,
including modulus zero and the zero receiver. -/
theorem dvd_signedShift_natAbs_iff_modEq (N m d : ℕ) :
    d ∣ ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs ↔ Nat.ModEq d m N := by
  rw [Nat.modEq_iff_dvd, Int.ofNat_dvd_left]

/-- On the original source side, the integer receiver is natural subtraction. -/
theorem signedShift_natAbs_eq_nat_sub {N m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ N) :
    ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs = N - m := by
  rw [← Int.ofNat_sub hm, Int.natAbs_natCast]

/-- The existing all-natural majorant gives nonnegativity for every integer. -/
theorem physicalDivisorSum_natAbs_nonneg_of_majorant
    (N z : ℕ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmajor : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (if Nat.Coprime n (sieveProduct N z) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho n) (n : ℤ) :
    0 ≤ physicalDivisorSum Q rho n.natAbs := by
  have h := hmajor n.natAbs
  split_ifs at h with hcop
  · exact zero_le_one.trans h
  · exact h

/-- Signed-shift finite Fubini has no support restriction m<=N. -/
theorem sum_weight_mul_physicalDivisorSum_signedShift_eq_rho_mul_finiteCongruenceMass
    (N : ℕ) (S Q : Finset ℕ) (weight rho : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ m ∈ S, weight m *
      physicalDivisorSum Q rho ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs) =
      ∑ d ∈ Q, rho d * finiteCongruenceMass S weight N d := by
  classical
  unfold physicalDivisorSum
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _hd
  unfold finiteCongruenceMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _hm
  have hiff : d ∣ ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs ↔ Nat.ModEq d m N :=
    dvd_signedShift_natAbs_iff_modEq N m d
  by_cases hmod : Nat.ModEq d m N
  · simp only [if_pos (hiff.mpr hmod), if_pos hmod, mul_comm]
  · have hdvd : ¬d ∣ ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs := fun h => hmod (hiff.mp h)
    simp only [if_neg hdvd, if_neg hmod, mul_zero]

/-- The unrestricted receiver gives the same three signed physical terms. -/
theorem sum_weight_mul_physicalDivisorSum_signedShift_eq_same_rho_main_add_errors
    (N : ℕ) (S Q : Finset ℕ) (weight rho : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ m ∈ S, weight m *
      physicalDivisorSum Q rho ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs) =
      finiteSourceMass S weight * physicalDensitySum Q rho +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d *
          ((finiteCoprimeMass S weight d - finiteSourceMass S weight) /
            (Nat.totient d : ℝ))) +
        ∑ d ∈ Q, rho d * finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy S weight N d := by
  rw [sum_weight_mul_physicalDivisorSum_signedShift_eq_rho_mul_finiteCongruenceMass
    N S Q weight rho]
  unfold physicalDensitySum finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _hd
  ring

/-- Every original source receiver is unchanged before positive outer extension. -/
theorem sum_physicalDivisorSum_realHalfProductSource_eq_signedShift
    (b : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T, physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) =
      ∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs := by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  rw [signedShift_natAbs_eq_nat_sub (mem_realHalfProductSource.mp hm).1]

/-- Positive outer comparison with arbitrary finite support, including m>N.
No density, distribution, clipping or hSN premise is introduced. -/
theorem RealB_cast_le_same_rho_signedShift_outer_main_add_errors
    {b T : ℝ} (N z : ℕ) (S Q : Finset ℕ) (weight rho : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hb : b < 1) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hsource : realHalfProductSource b N T ⊆ S)
    (houter : ∀ m ∈ S,
      (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ weight m)
    (hmajor : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (if Nat.Coprime n (sieveProduct N z) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho n) :
    (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
      finiteSourceMass S weight * physicalDensitySum Q rho +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d *
          ((finiteCoprimeMass S weight d - finiteSourceMass S weight) /
            (Nat.totient d : ℝ))) +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d * finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy S weight N d) +
        (z : ℝ) + (T + 1) := by
  classical
  have hnonneg : ∀ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ physicalDivisorSum Q rho ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs := by
    intro m
    exact physicalDivisorSum_natAbs_nonneg_of_majorant N z Q rho hmajor
      ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ))
  have hsum :
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T, physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) ≤
        ∑ m ∈ S, weight m *
          physicalDivisorSum Q rho ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs := by
    rw [sum_physicalDivisorSum_realHalfProductSource_eq_signedShift b N T Q rho]
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
          physicalDivisorSum Q rho ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs) =
          ∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
            (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
              physicalDivisorSum Q rho ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro m hm
        simp only [hm, if_pos, one_mul]
      _ = ∑ m ∈ S,
          (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
            physicalDivisorSum Q rho ((N : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)).natAbs := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset hsource
        intro m _hmS hmSource
        simp only [if_neg hmSource, zero_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun m hm =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (houter m hm) (hnonneg m)
  have h := (RealB_cast_le_sum_physicalDivisorSum_add_cap_cutoff
    N z Q rho hb hT hmajor).trans
      (add_le_add (add_le_add hsum (le_refl (z : ℝ))) (le_refl (T + 1)))
  rw [sum_weight_mul_physicalDivisorSum_signedShift_eq_same_rho_main_add_errors
    N S Q weight rho] at h
  exact h

end
end ImbalancedChen

span.literal_source:
For a prime $\ell$, squarefree support and boundedness give
\[
 \sum_{q:\ell\mid q}\frac{|\rho_N(q)|}{\varphi(q)}
       \ll\frac{\log N}{\ell-1}.
\]
Hence, by a union bound over the fixed number of original prime slots,
\begin{equation}
 \left|\sum_q\frac{\rho_N(q)}{\varphi(q)}
                         (X_W^{(q)}-X_W)\right|
       \ll X_WN^{-a_*}\log N=o(H_N).
 \label{eq:current-coprime-correction}
\end{equation}
No factor $N^{\theta_*}$ is introduced.  Small prime remainders cost
$N^{\rho_0+o(1)}$.  The smooth complete-product trim costs
$N^{1-\kappa_0+o(1)}$ after the full modulus sum; its product is
strictly below $N$, so no $\tau(0)$ occurs.  Positive majorization
before distribution gives
\[
 \sum_{m<N,\,N-m\ {\rm prime}}W_N(m)
 \le\sum_m W_N(m)R_N(N-m)+o(H_N)
 \le X_WS_N+o(H_N).
\]
Outer approximations with $m\ge N$ are harmless because
$R_N(n)\ge0$ for every integer.  Now apply
\eqref{eq:current-upper-density}.  Fixed geometric boundaries are
handled by positive smooth outer approximation, with $N$ tending to
infinity before the approximation error tends to zero.  At each
precision the same $\rho_N$ is used in the pointwise inequality,
density and distribution formula.  It need not be the same
coefficient at different precisions.  No division by $J$ is made.

manuscript.relevant_literal: Outer approximations with m>=N are harmless because R_N(n)>=0 for every integer; at each precision the same rho_N is used in the pointwise inequality,density and distribution. No division by family mass.

/-- Exact three-term decomposition: density, coprime correction, and signed
distribution error.  All three terms contain the identical `rho`. -/
theorem sum_rho_mul_halfProductCongruenceMass_eq
    (num den N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, rho q * halfProductCongruenceMass num den N T q) =
      ((halfProductSource num den N T).card : ℝ) *
          physicalDensitySum Q rho +
        physicalCoprimeCorrection num den N T Q rho +
        physicalDistributionError num den N T Q rho := by
  unfold physicalDensitySum physicalCoprimeCorrection physicalDistributionError
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q hq
  ring

/-- The total weight on the common finite carrier. -/
def finiteSourceMass (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S, w m

/-- The literal weighted sum in the residue class `a` modulo `d`. -/
def finiteCongruenceMass (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S with Nat.ModEq d m a, w m

/-- The literal weighted sum restricted to integers coprime to `d`. -/
def finiteCoprimeMass (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S with Nat.Coprime m d, w m

/-- The actual coprime-normalized discrepancy. Its definition also makes
sense for nonprimitive classes and for Lean's totalized division at zero. -/
def finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  finiteCongruenceMass S w a d - finiteCoprimeMass S w d / (Nat.totient d : ℝ)

theorem RealB_cast_le_sum_physicalDivisorSum_add_cap_cutoff
    {b T : ℝ} (N z : ℕ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hb : b < 1) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hmajor : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (if Nat.Coprime n (sieveProduct N z) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho n) :
    (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) + (z : ℝ) + (T + 1) := by
  exact (RealB_cast_le_realSiftedHalfProductSource_card_add_cap_cutoff N z hb hT).trans
    (add_le_add (add_le_add
      (realSiftedHalfProductSource_card_le_sum_physicalDivisorSum b N z T Q rho hmajor)
      (le_refl (z : ℝ))) (le_refl (T + 1)))

theorem sum_weight_mul_physicalDivisorSum_eq_rho_mul_finiteCongruenceMass
    (N : ℕ) (S Q : Finset ℕ) (weight rho : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hSN : ∀ m ∈ S, m ≤ N) :
    (∑ m ∈ S, weight m * physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) =
      ∑ d ∈ Q, rho d * finiteCongruenceMass S weight N d := by
  classical
  unfold physicalDivisorSum
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  unfold finiteCongruenceMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  have hiff : d ∣ N - m ↔ Nat.ModEq d m N := dvd_sub_iff_modEq_of_le (hSN m hm)
  by_cases hmod : Nat.ModEq d m N
  · simp only [if_pos (hiff.mpr hmod), if_pos hmod, mul_comm]
  · have hdvd : ¬d ∣ N - m := fun h => hmod (hiff.mp h)
    simp only [if_neg hdvd, if_neg hmod, mul_zero]

/-- The weighted outer-source decomposition keeps the sign of rho until
after the complete physical modulus sum. No absolute discrepancy sum is
introduced by the outer comparison. -/
theorem sum_weight_mul_physicalDivisorSum_eq_same_rho_main_add_errors
    (N : ℕ) (S Q : Finset ℕ) (weight rho : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hSN : ∀ m ∈ S, m ≤ N) :
    (∑ m ∈ S, weight m * physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) =
      finiteSourceMass S weight * physicalDensitySum Q rho +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d *
          ((finiteCoprimeMass S weight d - finiteSourceMass S weight) /
            (Nat.totient d : ℝ))) +
        ∑ d ∈ Q, rho d * finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy S weight N d := by
  rw [sum_weight_mul_physicalDivisorSum_eq_rho_mul_finiteCongruenceMass
    N S Q weight rho hSN]
  unfold physicalDensitySum finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  ring

/-- Positive outer approximation is performed before the signed
distribution decomposition. This finite implication does not assert that
an arbitrary outer weight is admissible in an analytic supplier. The
carrier here stays below N; an extension beyond N needs an integer shift. -/
theorem RealB_cast_le_same_rho_outer_main_add_errors
    {b T : ℝ} (N z : ℕ) (S Q : Finset ℕ) (weight rho : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hb : b < 1) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hSN : ∀ m ∈ S, m ≤ N)
    (hsource : realHalfProductSource b N T ⊆ S)
    (houter : ∀ m ∈ S,
      (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ weight m)
    (hmajor : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (if Nat.Coprime n (sieveProduct N z) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho n) :
    (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
      finiteSourceMass S weight * physicalDensitySum Q rho +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d *
          ((finiteCoprimeMass S weight d - finiteSourceMass S weight) /
            (Nat.totient d : ℝ))) +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d * finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy S weight N d) +
        (z : ℝ) + (T + 1) := by
  classical
  have hnonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ physicalDivisorSum Q rho n := by
    intro n
    have h := hmajor n
    split_ifs at h with hcop
    · exact zero_le_one.trans h
    · exact h
  have hsum :
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) ≤
      ∑ m ∈ S, weight m * physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
          physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) =
          ∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
            (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
              physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro m hm
        simp only [hm, if_pos, one_mul]
      _ = ∑ m ∈ S,
          (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
            physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset hsource
        intro m hmS hmSource
        simp only [if_neg hmSource, zero_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun m hm =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (houter m hm) (hnonneg (N - m))
  have h := (RealB_cast_le_sum_physicalDivisorSum_add_cap_cutoff
    N z Q rho hb hT hmajor).trans
      (add_le_add (add_le_add hsum (le_refl (z : ℝ))) (le_refl (T + 1)))
  rw [sum_weight_mul_physicalDivisorSum_eq_same_rho_main_add_errors
    N S Q weight rho hSN] at h
  exact h

/-- The actual all-integer roughness indicator is the literal finite
sieve-product indicator. This includes zero and negative test integers
and every target, without an evenness or target-positivity restriction. -/
theorem actualSmallRoughIndicator_eq_sieveProduct_natAbs
    (N : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (n : ℤ) :
    actualSmallRoughIndicator N z n =
      if Nat.Coprime n.natAbs (sieveProduct N (Nat.ceil z)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
  classical
  have hiff := actualSmallPrimeProduct_coprime_natAbs_iff
    N (Nat.ceil z) z (Nat.le_ceil z) n
  rw [actualSmallPrimeProduct_eq_sieveProduct_ceil N (Nat.ceil z) z
    (Nat.le_ceil z)] at hiff
  rw [actualSmallRoughIndicator, ← hiff]
  simp only [Nat.coprime_comm]

/-- The proved majorant of the literal small/rough coefficient supplies
the exact premise of the real-source finite bridge. The natural sieve cap
is the ceiling of the same real z used by this coefficient. -/
theorem actualSmallRoughRho_sieveProduct_majorant
    (retainOdd : List ℕ → Bool) (N cap : ℕ) (w z L : ℝ)
    (hL : 1 < L) (hwL : w ≤ L) (hwz : w ≤ z)
    (hzcap : z ≤ (cap : ℝ)) (n : ℕ) :
    (if Nat.Coprime n (sieveProduct N (Nat.ceil z)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      physicalDivisorSum (actualSmallRoughModuli retainOdd N cap w z)
        (actualSmallRoughRho retainOdd N cap w z L) n := by
  have h := actualSmallRoughRho_majorant retainOdd N cap w z L
    hL hwL hwz hzcap (n : ℤ)
  rw [actualSmallRoughIndicator_eq_sieveProduct_natAbs] at h
  simpa only [Int.natAbs_natCast] using h

@[simp] theorem natAbs_dvd_natAbs {a b : Int} : natAbs a ∣ natAbs b ↔ a ∣ b := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨k, hk⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨k, hk⟩ => ⟨natAbs k, hk.symm ▸ natAbs_mul a k⟩⟩
  rw [← natAbs_natCast k, ← natAbs_mul, natAbs_eq_natAbs_iff] at hk
  cases hk <;> subst b
  · apply Int.dvd_mul_right
  · rw [← Int.mul_neg]; apply Int.dvd_mul_right

theorem ofNat_dvd_left {n : Nat} {z : Int} : (↑n : Int) ∣ z ↔ n ∣ z.natAbs := by
  rw [← natAbs_dvd_natAbs, natAbs_natCast]

theorem prod_congr (h : s₁ = s₂) : (∀ x ∈ s₂, f x = g x) → s₁.prod f = s₂.prod g := by
  rw [h]; exact fold_congr

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_subset (h : s₁ ⊆ s₂) (hf : ∀ x ∈ s₂, x ∉ s₁ → f x = 1) :
    ∏ x ∈ s₁, f x = ∏ x ∈ s₂, f x :=
  haveI := Classical.decEq ι
  prod_subset_one_on_sdiff h (by simpa) fun _ _ => rfl

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_mul_distrib : ∏ x ∈ s, f x * g x = (∏ x ∈ s, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s, g x :=
  Eq.trans (by rw [one_mul]; rfl) fold_op_distrib

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 1 :=
  calc
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s with p a, if p a then f a else 1 :=
      prod_congr rfl fun a h => by rw [if_pos]; simpa using (mem_filter.1 h).2
    _ = ∏ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 1 := by
      { refine prod_subset (filter_subset _ s) fun x hs h => ?_
        rw [mem_filter, not_and] at h
        exact if_neg (by simpa using h hs) }

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_comm {s : Finset γ} {t : Finset α} {f : γ → α → β} :
    (∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t, f x y) = ∏ y ∈ t, ∏ x ∈ s, f x y :=
  prod_comm' fun _ _ => Iff.rfl

lemma sum_mul (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a = ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a := map_sum (AddMonoidHom.mulRight a) _ s

lemma mul_sum (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R) :
    a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i = ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i := map_sum (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft a) _ s
